title: Foundry .foundry/build-provenance.yaml
description: The committed per-atom build-provenance marker (a tree-covered file, not PR-body text). Pins the adopter workspace commit each implemented atom was authorized against (cross-repo content-addressed precedence) and carries a LIST of per-atom authorizations (multi-atom PRs recorded per-subject, in-toto/SLSA style). The bespoke emitter and merge-gate revalidator that originally produced/consumed this file were retired in the v0.24.0 subtraction; today it is an adopter-written convention that foundry-deploy-status.py reads as a deploy-identity source.

model_pin.description: Model id that implemented (incident forensics + model-pin-regression diffing).

prompt_hash.description: Hash of the implementing prompt, if captured. Best-effort v1.

merge_autonomy_mode.description: Single per PR (the whole PR merges under one mode). Cross-checked by the gate vs the actual merge actor/path.

built_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Corroborating-only (§22.6c); the binding ordering proof is the content-addressed pin.

authorizations.description: One entry per authorized atom implemented in this PR.

foundry_authorized_against.description: <repo>@<sha> the atom was authorized against — the commit whose tree carries the frozen authorized: block (precedence by construction; the retired gate used to re-fetch and assert this mechanically, reviewers check it today).

supersedes.description: Prior contract_sha256 this auth superseded, or null.
